_how_to_edit: Where booking enquiries go. Fill in what you have and leave the rest as "". web3formsKey: the access key from web3forms.com, which lets the form send straight to your email with no server (see the README). enquiryEmail: the address that should receive enquiries; it is also the fallback if the form cannot send. whatsappNumber: digits only with the country code, for example 18765551234; the WhatsApp buttons stay hidden until this is filled in. formEndpoint: optional web address of another form service, used only when there is no Web3Forms key. Save the file and the website updates.
